title: Half past kissing time, time to kiss again
html_source:
https://www3.amherst.edu/~rjyanco94/literature/eugenefield/poems/poemsofchildhood/kissingtime.html
by Eugene Field (1850-1895)

Also ‘A stock phrase, usually addressed to children who ask what time it is’ (Gifford & Seidman, p392).

anchor.text: half past kissing time, time to kiss again
anchor.prefix: schief out of that so that was why she just gave a gentle hint about its being late. And when Cissy came up Edy asked her the time and Miss Cissy, as glib as you like, said it was
anchor.suffix:
. But Edy wanted to know because they were told to be in early. 

 — Wait, said Cissy, I'll ask my uncle Peter over there what's the time by his conundrum. 

 So over she went and
anchor.canonical_text: half past kissing time, time to kiss again
